hero.meta: Risk-Free Trial · Forever Free Edition Available · No Card Required

suite.title: One platform. The whole back office.
suite.lede: Most contracting software locks you in, then forces you to learn a new system. Kickback is built as a platform from the start — one login, one job graph, one set of crews and customers, sourced from the tools you already use, shared across every app in the platform.

pillars.title: One Source of Truth
pillars.body: Every part of the platform reads from the same jobs, customers, crews, and vendors, from the CRM you already use.

pillars.title: One Login
pillars.body: Add your teammates to the platform once. Give them access to one app, just a few, or all of them.

pillars.title: One Connection
pillars.body: Connect your CRM and your supplier accounts to the platform. Data flows automatically, so you can get right to work.

pillars.title: One Trusted Platform
pillars.body: Bank-grade encryption of your supplier credentials, and secure storage of your data. Peace of mind, without duct tape and string.

features.title: Built for the back office, by people who'd rather be in the field.

items.title: Get your weekend back.
items.body: The receipts pile that used to take a Saturday afternoon clears in under fifteen minutes. The platform handles the data entry; you just confirm what's right.

items.title: Strengthen your relationships.
items.body: Never forget a detail, never lose a lead, and never miss a chance to close. The AI keeps your customer relationships strong, drafting in your voice with context from across your business.

items.title: Stop juggling apps.
items.body: Kickback pushes data back into your CRM and pulls data from the tools you already use, and keeps everything in sync without double-entry, juggling multiple apps, or sharing passwords.

quote.text: Job Costing used to give me anxiety. Now, it takes five minutes every morning and everything's in sync.
